name: local-context-assistant
description: Local-only context indexing and retrieval assistant

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && sh -c 'if command -v dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1; then dotnet publish tools/csharp-roslyn-worker/Worker.csproj -c Release -o dist/roslyn; else echo "warning: dotnet not found; skipping Roslyn worker build"; fi'
